description: This file defines a React custom hook `useRandomBanner` that manages selecting and providing a random banner image from a curated list. It supports optional locking to a specific image source and provides a transition key for animation purposes.

methods.name: useRandomBanner(lockSrc)
methods.description: React hook to select a random banner image from a curated list on initial mount. Supports locking to a specific source and provides transition key and curated list.
